exposure: reuse of the same cerclage suture
cohort: The study included 20 women with cervical insufficiency who underwent history-indicated modified transvaginal cervicoisthmic cerclage and completed two pregnancies with the same cerclage suture in place.
finding: Utilizing the same cerclage suture for history-indicated modified transvaginal cervicoisthmic cerclage can effectively maintain favorable pregnancy outcomes in both initial and subsequent pregnancies for women with cervical insufficiency.
gest_age: Mean gestational age at delivery was 37.6 ± 0.9 weeks in first pregnancies and 36.7 ± 3.2 weeks in second pregnancies.
